hook.name: Primer Adaptive Burns v2
hook.description: PRHook collects a configurable fee (0–5% hard cap) on swaps involving the Primer (PR) token in owner-allowlisted pools, routing collected amounts to a buyback vault. Exact-output swaps pay the fee in the output token via beforeSwap delta; exact-input swaps pay from realized output via afterSwap delta. Fee rates for buys and sells are independently adjustable by an owner-designated operator within configurable bounds.
